title: Pure Fire Fist
summary: The Brotherhood of the Fire Fist and its Fire Formation Spells/Traps, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Fire Fists are FIRE Beast-Warriors that Set Fire Formation cards straight from the Deck, then send those face-up cards to the GY to pay for their effects. Fire Formation - Tenki searches a Level 4 Beast-Warrior. Bear and Gorilla trade a face-up Fire Formation for a destroyed monster or Spell/Trap, and Tiger King Sets one when Xyz Summoned. The 2019 cards lead. Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Elephant trades a face-up Fire Formation for another Fire Fist from the hand, and later fetches a Level 5+ one. Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Panda summons itself whenever you activate a Fire Formation, bringing back another Fire Fist. Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Ram Sets a different Fire Formation. Fire Formation - Domei Ritual Summons Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Eland, which negates a monster effect, and Fire Formation - Ingen Fusion Summons Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Swan. Ultimate Fire Formation - Sinto negates a Spell or Trap.
